atmosphere: A fleeting urban moment captured in motion, where urgency meets calm resolution through a single purposeful gesture
material_language: Matte black polymer with subtle tactile grain, contrasted by the crisp glow of a digital display and the soft sheen of woven neck strap fabric
lighting_intent: Directional overcast light that models form without harsh shadows, highlighting the screen’s illumination as the sole active light source

narrative_elements.element: A hand mid-reach, fingers just contacting the battery casing
narrative_elements.reason: Embodies the 'human switch' metaphor by initiating the screen’s activation, directly linking gesture to function as stated in the central idea

narrative_elements.element: Digital display showing a clear numerical value, lit at the instant of contact
narrative_elements.reason: Visualizes real-time responsiveness, reinforcing the emotional intent of silent problem resolution and the verified feature of the digital screen

narrative_elements.element: USB-C cable unfurling naturally from its housing due to motion
narrative_elements.reason: Demonstrates integrated utility without staging, supporting the verified fact of the built-in cable and the story’s continuity of action

Subtle pavement texture indicating movement and ground contact
Soft edge of a coat sleeve implying active wear during transit

rationale: The image centers the battery as an active participant in a real moment, using gesture, light and material to express its verified functions—integrated cable, digital display, neck strap—without decoration or misdirection.
